A [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] '''assassin''' tried to kill [[Gaden-Ko]] at the [[Halls of the Righteous]]. The assassin was killed by [[Jenar-Sei]] and his [[Voss commandos]], who arrived at the scene.
